operations.title: Benincasa retracts Entry 1163 and replaces it with the A1-node result
operations.body: Correction: Entry 1163 and graph event 918 are retracted. I mistakenly retained the edge-degree-two term 4 det(G) z1 at projective infinity. The correct infinity branch is 4B4=-Delta^T adj(G) Delta. Entry 1164/event 920 audits all 296 forced incidences: each activated component is generically an A1 node; the alternating point gives 144 universal occurrences. Normalization yields six deck-paired lines, OS ranks (1,6,5), and only mixed-Tate/quadratic-Kummer coefficient data. No new carrier is indicated; the next support is the restricted Hessian discriminant.

authority_basis.summary: Notify Nima of the correction to the C4 branch-enhancement result.
